title: Why Do Veins Have Valves?
description:
The Tied Arm That Proved Your Blood Circulates
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wwcjcFfC-5M

Each valve stops blood pushed towards the hand and lets it slide through towards the heart.

social.hook: The flaps in a vein let blood move only one way.
social.question: Guess which way the blood is allowed to go?
social.alt: A vein drawing with one-way flaps, the valves Fabricius found.
